name: Summoner's Stone: Subdued Mistress reskins the Hero's summoned demon (#8201)
contract: The wardrobe's Summoned Demon category (AppearanceCategories 34, APPEARANCE_TYPE_COSMETIC_PET, class mask 768 = Warlock and Hero) lists Summoner's Stones; each Appearances.dbc row names a creature entry at field 8. Appearance 753 (item 204016, Summoner's Stone: Subdued Mistress) names creature 45906, display 70007 (AscensionCollectionModelData).

Only the Tamed Beast category (33) had a handler (#7160); category 34 was saved but never read back by anything, so confirming a Summoner's Stone never changed how the Hero's demon looked (reported against the Enslave Demon pet, #8201; the pet-power half of the same report is #8291, out of scope here).

The fix reads the saved selection's creature display the same way RefreshIncarnationGuardian does for incarnations, and applies it to any Warlock or Hero SUMMON_PET-type guardian both when it is (re)summoned and when the selection changes while it is already out; clearing the selection restores its native display. This scenario proves the mechanism with Summon Imp (688), which already reaches the same Guardian::InitStatsForLevel hook as the Enslave Demon kit's own Summon Demon (884); a class outside the mask is refused.

steps.label: SETUP: mana pool for the summon
The imp's own model, before any Summoner's Stone is selected
Select the Subdued Mistress Summoner's Stone with the imp out
THE FIX: the imp takes the Subdued Mistress display at once
THE FIX: a newly summoned imp also takes the selected display
Clearing the selection restores the imp's own model
A Warrior selects the Subdued Mistress Summoner's Stone
Summoned Demon appearances are not offered to warriors
